title: Qualitative Evaluation Approaches and Methods
description: Explores the methodologies and methods used in qualitative evaluation. Provides knowledge about selected evaluation approaches and designs, such as participatory evaluation and Indigenous evaluation. Presents methods such as individual interviewing, focus group and photo-voice. Strategies for analyzing, reporting and enhancing credibility and quality are explored.
recommendations: ADMN 437 or ADMN 537 recommended prior to ADMN 580.
